primary_ux_fallback.spec: Typical user opens the app and navigates to the calendar view. They then select a date using the number picker input fields, which are arranged in a horizontal row with 7 fields for each month (Sextidi, Jun, Prairial, etc.). The selected date is then displayed on the map view, where they can navigate up to return to the main screen or pan/zoom the map. The user may also access settings by tapping the help button and selecting 'SETTINGS' from the options menu.
